product.name: Core Gameboard Technology
product.description: A modular gameboard system that supports various casual puzzle game mechanics like match-2, match-3, and merge games, enabling real-time player interactions and flexible game development.

product.name: LiveOps Platform
product.description: A backend service platform that manages live game operations including events, tournaments, player communication, and data synchronization across devices.

product.name: Casual Puzzle Games Portfolio
product.description: A collection of casual puzzle games including titles like Lily’s Garden, Cookie Cats, Simon’s Cat series, and Makeover Match, designed for mobile platforms.
